svg.title: Боковая ходьба с резинкой в руках — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Lateral anti-rotation walk with resistance band held in both hands. One visible fixed upright post to left of athlete, band anchored at chest height, running to clasped hands held with arms nearly straight in front of sternum IN BOTH frames. Full-body front three-quarter view. Athlete torso faces forward, steps sideways AWAY from anchor with slightly bent knees: left picture is wide split step with right foot reaching farther right, right picture has left foot following right, both feet farther away from the post. Make a modest but visible change in distance from post. Arms stay extended equally in both pictures. The band is only held in hands, never at knees or ankles. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
